steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Playground in Filter environments. Click Playground, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Make two pairs: the Lion Fish with the Fishing Net, and the Cargo Truck with the Shovel. Set the Panther between them.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ is a threat because ___. The ___ helps because ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

studio.title: Design a crossing

labels.start: Tap tiles to build your path. Tap a tile again to remove it.
labels.c2: It goes under the road in a tunnel.
labels.noPath: The panther can't get across yet. Look for a gap in your path.
labels.tooMany: It works, but it uses too many tiles. Can you make it shorter?
labels.done: You designed, tested and improved your crossings. Nice work, engineer!

studio.look: A drawn model map seen from above. A highway cuts a panther's forest in two. A wildlife crossing is a safe path that lets animals get across. Criteria are what the design must do. A constraint is a limit, like how many tiles you can use.
studio.do: Tap tiles to build a path from forest to forest. Road tiles turn into a tunnel. Tap Test it. If a check is red, fix your path and test again.

frames.starter: My crossing helps the panther because ___.

studio.full: You built and tested 2 crossings and picked why. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

maps.name: Design it
maps.q: Build a crossing for the panther. Use {from} tiles or fewer.
maps.alt: Florida panther walking through a green forest
maps.ok: It works! The panther can cross under the highway.

maps.name: Improve it
maps.q: A new spot has a lake and houses. Build a crossing with {from} tiles or fewer.
maps.alt: A highway and a canal cutting straight across the Everglades
maps.ok: It works! You found a way around the lake and the houses.

studio.allBuilt: Both crossings work. Real engineers built crossings like these under highways in Florida.

voice.brief: Welcome to the countryside, crew. We film Scene 31, Threat and Fix. Pair each threat with a fix, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Countryside, and pick The Countryside. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Put the lionfish by the net, and the truck by the shovel. Set the panther between them. Then tell me each threat and fix.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a clean way to make power. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
